## Verdict
REVISE — evidence/app1.log confirms missing /tmp/home/app-data, a harness setup failure before Java, not a product defect.
## Critical gaps
run.py:sandbox omits required directories; workflow.py:close checks only immediate children/process-group members, missing reparented or setsid descendants; cleanup deletes the document without retaining before/after bytes. run.py:pins does not fingerprint all rootfs executables/libraries used.
## Important improvements
private_input.c pins client/surface but needs destruction invalidation; workflow.py accepts PID-only, potentially stale editor observations and coordinates. editor_probe.c must establish GTK-context ownership and pinned WrapperWidget/JNI weak-reference lifecycle; cached selection does not establish continuing editor uniqueness.
## Validation gaps
Add tests for directory creation, stale/wrong-surface observations, focus loss, destroyed/replaced editors, JNI faults, Save ambiguity, close refusal/nonzero exit, reparented descendants, trailing fatal output, EOF failure and cap overflow; current tests largely check strings or isolated predicates.
## Recommended revision
Create explicit app-data/config/data/runtime/cache/profile directories and a new immutable evidence revision; retain one fixture creation and app-only subsequent target writes. Bind disposable project-owned document/profile storage into separate per-stage PID namespaces, restarting private services; attest app natural exit0 separately, then wait for namespace teardown before reopen, retaining existing real Save/close controls and fresh second-process editor readback. Add destruction-safe identity/focus checks before each input and fresh sequence-bound editor geometry, verify JNI lifecycle against pinned implementation, retain bounded exact document snapshots before cleanup, enforce EOF/fatal/cap gates, and fingerprint the full no-follow rootfs tree or state exact limited provenance scope.
